text: dsh-mcp-bridge 是将 DeepSeek Harness 工具提供给 MCP 客户端的 DSH 插件。它在 DSH webServer 上注册 HTTP 路由，默认路径为 /mcp，并把 agent scope 中的工具转换为 MCP 工具目录。客户端可发现并调用工具，默认开放 read、glob、grep 和 web_search。工具结果转换为 MCP 文本响应，工具目录变化时会向连接客户端发送通知。适合希望从 Claude Code、Codex 等 MCP 客户端调用 DSH 工具的用户；需要 DSH 的 webServer 与 tools 服务。

dsh-mcp-bridge exposes DSH tools to MCP clients over HTTP at /mcp. Clients list and call agent-scoped tools; the default allowlist includes read, glob, grep, and web_search. Results use MCP format, and connected clients receive change notifications. Requires DSH webServer and tools services.
想让 Claude Code 通过 MCP 调用 DSH 里的搜索和读取工具。
如何把 DSH 的工具目录开放给其他 MCP 客户端发现？
我想从 Codex 调用当前 DSH agent 可用的工具。
让 DSH 的工具通过一个 HTTP MCP 服务对外提供。
How can I let an MCP client discover and call tools from my DSH instance?
I want to use DSH tools from Claude Code over an HTTP MCP endpoint.
dsh-mcp-bridge 的功能「暴露 DSH 工具目录」：筛选 agent 工具并转换为 MCP 名称、描述和输入格式，默认列出 read、glob、grep、web_search；客户端用 tools/list 获取。
dsh-mcp-bridge 的功能「调用 DSH 工具」：MCP 客户端调用 dsh_<工具名> 时，服务端将参数转发至对应 agent 的 DSH tools 执行接口，并把文本结果映射为 MCP 响应。
dsh-mcp-bridge 的功能「提供 HTTP MCP 传输」：在配置路径注册 HTTP 路由，POST 处理 JSON-RPC 请求，GET 或 subscriptions/listen 建立 SSE 通知流。
dsh-mcp-bridge 的功能「通知工具目录变化」：DSH 工具发生变化时，向已连接的 MCP 客户端广播 tools/list_changed 通知，使客户端可重新获取工具列表。
有没有办法把 DSH 当前可用的工具接到 MCP 协议上？
Expose my DSH tools through a streamable HTTP MCP server.

> Expose DeepSeek Harness tools as a standard **MCP Server** — drive `dsh` from Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, or any MCP-compatible client.

dsh-mcp-bridge README · dsh-mcp-bridge：`dsh-mcp-bridge` turns your running DeepSeek Harness into a Model Context Protocol server over **streamable HTTP**. Any MCP client can discover and call the real DSH tools (file read, glob, grep, web search…) through a **safe allowlist** — while your workspace keeps DSH's own sandbox and approval pipeline on every call.

Zero dependencies. Zero build step. Install and go.

dsh-mcp-bridge README · Why：| | Official `dsh-mcp-client` | **dsh-mcp-bridge (this)** |
|---|---|---|
| Direction | DSH → external MCP **servers** (bring tools *in*) | External MCP **clients** → DSH (expose tools *out*) |
| Transport | stdio / streamable-http client | streamable HTTP **server** at `/mcp` |
| Client UI | none (YAML config) | — (roadmap: management panel) |

The official client answers "how do I use MCP servers in dsh?". This project answers the reverse: "how do other agents use **dsh** as a tool provider?".
dsh-mcp-bridge README · 1. Install the bundle：```sh
dsh-mcp-bridge README · from a checkout：dsh plugin --profile <name> add ./mcp-bridge

dsh-mcp-bridge README · or from GitHub (zero build — plain JS)：dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:you/dsh-mcp-bridge
```
section: or from GitHub (zero build — plain JS)

text:
dsh-mcp-bridge README · 2. Configure (optional)：The bundle's `cordis.patch.yml` already mounts the server on `/mcp` with the safe default allowlist. Tune it in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: mcp-bridge
  config:
    path: /mcp                        # endpoint path
    allowlist:                        # DSH tools exposed to MCP clients
dsh-mcp-bridge README · 3. Connect any MCP client：```sh
dsh-mcp-bridge README · Claude Code：claude mcp add --transport http dsh http://127.0.0.1:3080/mcp

dsh-mcp-bridge README · URL: http://127.0.0.1:3080/mcp：```

Tools appear as `dsh_<name>` (e.g. `dsh_read`, `dsh_glob`, `dsh_grep`, `dsh_web_search`).

dsh-mcp-bridge README · Security model：- **Default allowlist** exposes only read-only, low-risk tools (`read`, `glob`, `grep`, `web_search`).
- **Hard denylist** (`pwsh`, `write`, `edit`, subagent orchestration, cordis control…) can never be exposed — even if misconfigured into the allowlist.
- Every call still runs through DSH's own **sandbox + approval** pipeline.
- Serve on loopback (`127.0.0.1`) only; do not bind `0.0.0.0` unless you know the network is trusted.

dsh-mcp-bridge README · Bidirectional: bring tools in too：`dsh-mcp-bridge` covers the **out** direction (DSH → MCP clients). For the **in** direction (attach third-party MCP servers to DSH), use the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` — one line per server in your `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: mcp-github
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: github

Your model then sees `mcp__github__*` tools alongside the `dsh_*` tools this bridge exposes. Together they make DSH a full citizen of the MCP ecosystem:

dsh-mcp-bridge README · Bidirectional: bring tools in too：```
Claude Code ──HTTP──▶ dsh-mcp-bridge ──▶ DSH tools (read/glob/grep/web_search)
DSH model   ──stdio─▶ dsh-mcp-client ──▶ any MCP server (GitHub/filesystem/…)
```

Full example: [`examples/bidirectional.cordis.patch.yml`](examples/bidirectional.cordis.patch.yml) · Claude Code quickstart: [`examples/claude-code-connect.md`](examples/claude-code-connect.md)

dsh-mcp-bridge README · How it works：```
MCP client ──streamable HTTP──▶ /mcp (webServer route)
                                  │ JSON-RPC 2.0 (initialize / tools/list / tools/call)
                                  ▼
                        dsh-mcp-bridge protocol layer (zero-dep, pure JS)

The bridge enumerates tools through the agent-scope view of `ctx.tools` (agents are scope keys in dsh), so the tool set you expose matches what your agents actually have — no hardcoded schemas.

dsh-mcp-bridge README · Development：```sh
npm test          # node:test, zero dependencies (38 tests)
npm run demo      # live demo against a running DSH at http://127.0.0.1:3080/mcp
npm run demo:mock # e2e: repo code + official MCP SDK client (no DSH needed)
node .mcp-test/e2e-stateless.mjs [url]   # 2026-07-28 stateless-protocol e2e

Layout:

dsh-mcp-bridge README · Development：- `src/protocol.js` — JSON-RPC 2.0 message handling (pure, testable)
- `src/catalog.js` — allowlist/denylist tool projection
- `src/transport.js` — streamable HTTP handler (POST JSON, GET SSE)
- `src/dsh.js` — agent-scoped tools access + result mapping
- `src/index.js` — Cordis plugin entry (`apply(ctx, config)`)

dsh-mcp-bridge README · Roadmap：- [x] `notifications/tools/list_changed` when the DSH tool set changes (SSE broadcast)
- [x] Client-side management panel (server status, tool tree, connectivity self-test) — see `src/client.js`
- [x] MCP **2026-07-28 stateless mode**: no handshake, `server/discover`, request `_meta` versioning, `subscriptions/listen` stream
- [ ] Configurable `serverInfo`, pagination support
- [ ] Optional exposure of Resources/Prompts

dsh-mcp-bridge README · Protocol compatibility：| Client protocol | Behavior |
|---|---|
| 2025-06-18 | `initialize` handshake + GET SSE notifications (official MCP SDK verified) |
| 2026-07-28 | stateless: no handshake, version in request `_meta`, `server/discover`, POST `subscriptions/listen` stream |
